title: Frappe ERPNext 15.111.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.22.0 before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 15.111.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.22.0 before 16.36.0 contain a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated users, including portal users or those without roles, to access item rows from inter-company invoices or orders belonging to other companies without proper read permission checks. The vulnerability affects endpoints that accept a caller-supplied document type and return sales and purchase invoice and order items.
